component_change: Replacement creates new component identity and increments assembly version; invalidate downstream phase/mount/zero receipts.
phase_change: Physical indexing and measured phase receipt increment phase_state_version; commands and labels alone are insufficient.
history_claim: Family labels express source scope, not historical specimen serial numbers or chronology.

reuse.impact: terminal quarantine immediately after event; each later condition requires a distinct instance
reuse.other: qualified post-inspection and compatible material/topology/phase/mount card; repeated cycles are technical measurements, not independent samples

component_material_policy: Every component role and lot must match its family binding, including Taiji steel frames and micro steel shafts. An unknown shaft material is a required U_MATERIAL input, never a tacit match.
